description: Fetch Hive cross-merchant signal for the merchant's catalog: category benchmarks (avg images, top angles, etc.) alongside the merchant's own catalog stats for comparison. Use when the user asks 'how do I compare to similar stores?'

category.description: Optional category to benchmark against (apparel, beauty, home_decor, food_beverage, furniture, jewelry, footwear, fitness, electronics, diy_hardware). If omitted, returns insights across the most common category in the catalog.

name: get_network_insights
title: Network insights
